tasks.taskName: Score demand for size and value

steps.title: Pull the Triage-status items from the DEMAND project in Jira
sop: Open the DEMAND project in Jira and select the Issues view
Run the JQL filter project = DEMAND AND status = Triage scoped to the current PI window
Save the result as the shared scoring-worklist filter
Compare the worklist count to the filter result count
Done when the saved worklist holds every Triage item for the PI window
verify: Open the DEMAND project in Jira and re-run the Triage status filter for the PI window
Compare each returned issue key to the saved scoring worklist
Pass when the worklist matches the filter result item for item

steps.title: Enter the business value input on each item in Jira
sop: Open the scoring-worklist filter in the DEMAND project in Jira
Open each item and enter the score in the WSJF Business Value field
Save each item after entering the value
Done when the WSJF Business Value field is populated on every worklist item
verify: Run the scoring-worklist filter in Jira with the Business Value column displayed
Scan the column for empty cells
Pass when the business value field is populated on each

steps.title: Enter the time criticality input on each item in Jira
sop: Open the scoring-worklist filter in the DEMAND project in Jira
Open each item and enter the score in the WSJF Time Criticality field
Save each item after entering the value
Done when the Time Criticality field is populated on every worklist item
verify: Run the scoring-worklist filter in Jira with the Time Criticality column displayed
Scan the column for empty cells
Pass when the time criticality field is populated on each

steps.title: Enter the risk reduction input on each item in Jira
sop: Open the scoring-worklist filter in the DEMAND project in Jira
Open each item and enter the score in the WSJF Risk Reduction field
Save each item after entering the value
Done when the Risk Reduction field is populated on every worklist item
verify: Run the scoring-worklist filter in Jira with the Risk Reduction column displayed
Scan the column for empty cells
Pass when the risk reduction field is populated on each

steps.title: Enter the job size input on each item in Jira
sop: Open the scoring-worklist filter in the DEMAND project in Jira
Open each item and enter the estimate in the WSJF Job Size field
Save each item after entering the value
Done when the Job Size field is populated on every worklist item
verify: Run the scoring-worklist filter in Jira with the Job Size column displayed
Scan the column for empty cells
Pass when the job size field is populated on each

steps.title: Set the T-shirt size on each item in Jira
sop: Open the scoring-worklist filter in the DEMAND project in Jira
Open each item and pick a value from XS to XL in the T-Shirt Size field
Save each item after picking the size
Done when no worklist item is missing a T-Shirt Size value
verify: Run the scoring-worklist filter in Jira with the T-Shirt Size column displayed
Scan the column for blanks or values outside XS-XL
Pass when every size field holds an XS-XL value

steps.title: Set the 1-5 value score on each item in Jira
sop: Open the scoring-worklist filter in the DEMAND project in Jira
Open each item and enter a 1-5 score in the Value Score field
Save each item after entering the score
Done when every worklist item holds a 1-5 value score
verify: Run the scoring-worklist filter in Jira with the Value Score column displayed
Scan the column for blanks or values outside 1-5
Pass when every value score sits in the 1-5 range

steps.title: Record a one-line scoring rationale on each item in Jira
sop: Open each scored item from the scoring-worklist filter in the DEMAND project in Jira
Type a one-line rationale naming the scorer into the Scoring Rationale field
Save each item after entering the rationale
Done when every scored item carries a rationale with the scorer identity
verify: Open a sample of scored items from the worklist filter in Jira
Read the Scoring Rationale field on each sampled item
Pass when a one-line rationale with scorer is present on each

steps.title: Label unsizeable items needs-refinement in Jira
sop: Open each worklist item with missing requirements in the DEMAND project in Jira
Add the label needs-refinement on the item's detail panel
Add each labelled item to the agenda of the next backlog refinement session in Jira
Done when every labelled item is routed to a refinement session inside one sprint
verify: Run the filter label = needs-refinement in the DEMAND project in Jira
Open each returned item and check for its linked refinement session
Pass when each is routed to a refinement session

steps.title: Run the demand-scored-completeness filter to confirm zero unscored items in Jira
sop: Open the saved demand-scored-completeness JQL filter in the DEMAND project in Jira
Run the filter to list Triage items missing either the size or the value score
Open each returned item and fill the missing score
Re-run the filter after the fixes
Done when the filter returns zero Triage items without both scores
verify: Re-run the demand-scored-completeness filter in Jira
Read the result count
Pass when the result is empty

steps.title: Archive the scoring session notes in Confluence
sop: Open the demand management space in Confluence and click Create page
Paste the scoring session notes and title the page with the version and session date
Publish the page under the demand scoring parent page
Copy the page link into the description of the scoring board in Jira
Done when the published notes page is linked from the board
verify: Open the notes page from the scoring board link in Confluence
Check the title carries the version and session date
Pass when the dated versioned scoring notes are present

steps.title: Record the Demand Manager sign-off on the scoring outcome in Jira
sop: Open the scoring board in the DEMAND project in Jira
Review the completed PI scoring pass against the worklist
Post a board comment recording the Demand Manager sign-off with the date
Done when the dated sign-off comment sits on the board
verify: Open the scoring board in Jira and read the comments
Check for a Demand Manager sign-off comment carrying a date
Pass when a dated Demand Manager sign-off is present

steps.title: Add the team field to the survey form in Microsoft 365 / SharePoint
sop: Open the toolchain friction survey in Microsoft Forms and click Edit
Click Add new, pick Choice, name the question Team and list the engineering teams
Toggle Required on the question and save the form
Done when a preview submission is blocked until a team is selected
verify: Open the survey in Microsoft Forms and click Preview
Try to submit the form with the Team question left blank
Pass when the team field is marked required

steps.title: Add the role field to the survey form in Microsoft 365 / SharePoint
sop: Open the toolchain friction survey in Microsoft Forms and click Edit
Click Add new, pick Choice, name the question Role and list the engineering roles
Toggle Required on the question and save the form
Done when a preview submission is blocked until a role is selected
verify: Open the survey in Microsoft Forms and click Preview
Try to submit the form with the Role question left blank
Pass when the role field is marked required

steps.title: Add the friction-area field to the survey form in Microsoft 365 / SharePoint
sop: Open the toolchain friction survey in Microsoft Forms and click Edit
Add a Choice question named Friction area with options spanning local dev, build, test, deploy and release
Toggle Required on the question and save the form
Done when the required Friction area question lists choices covering local dev through release
verify: Open the survey in Microsoft Forms and read the Friction area choices
Check the options cover the toolchain stages from local dev through release
Pass when the friction-area choices span the toolchain areas

steps.title: Add the 1-5 severity field to the survey form in Microsoft 365 / SharePoint
sop: Open the toolchain friction survey in Microsoft Forms and click Edit
Add a Rating question named Severity and set the scale to 5 levels
Toggle Required on the question and save the form
Done when a preview submission is blocked until a 1-5 severity is picked
verify: Open the survey in Microsoft Forms and open the Severity question
Check the rating scale and the Required toggle
Pass when the severity scale runs 1 to 5

steps.title: Add the free-text example field to the survey form in Microsoft 365 / SharePoint
sop: Open the toolchain friction survey in Microsoft Forms and click Edit
Add a Text question named Example and enable Long answer
Save the form
Done when respondents can type a concrete friction example into the form
verify: Open the survey in Microsoft Forms and read the question list
Check for the long-answer Example question
Pass when the free-text example field exists

steps.title: Publish the survey to every active developer in Microsoft 365 / SharePoint
sop: Open the toolchain friction survey in Microsoft Forms and click Collect responses
Copy the link into an Outlook email to the engineering list covering every developer with a sprint of tenure
Send the email and note the send date
Set the survey close date 2 weeks out in the form settings
Done when the invite is sent and the 2-week window opens
verify: Open the sent invite in Outlook and read the recipient list
Compare the recipients to the roster of active developers
Pass when it covers all active developers

steps.title: Check the response rate against the 60 percent floor in Microsoft 365 / SharePoint
sop: Open the Responses tab of the survey in Microsoft Forms
Divide the response count by the invited count from the distribution list
Record the computed rate next to the 60 percent floor on the survey tracker page in Confluence
Done when the recorded rate stands against the 60 percent floor
verify: Open the Responses tab in Microsoft Forms and recompute respondents over invited
Compare the result to the recorded figure on the tracker page
Pass when the recorded figure is confirmed

steps.title: Send a reminder with an extension if the rate is short in Microsoft 365 / SharePoint
sop: Open the Responses tab of the survey in Microsoft Forms and read the current rate
If the rate is under 60 percent, send a reminder email to non-respondents through Outlook
Extend the survey close date by one week in the form settings
Done when the reminder is sent and the window is extended
verify: Open the sent items in Outlook and the close date in the Microsoft Forms settings
Check the reminder and the extension against the recorded rate
Pass when the reminder went out on a short rate

steps.title: Exclude incomplete responses from the quantitative rollup in BI/reporting platform
sop: Open the survey rollup dataset in Power BI Desktop
Open Power Query and add a filter removing rows with a blank severity or friction area
Apply the query and refresh the dataset
Done when only valid responses feed the rollup
verify: Open the rollup dataset in Power BI and inspect the response table
Filter for rows with a blank severity or friction area
Pass when no incomplete response rows remain

steps.title: Reconcile per-team response counts to the total in BI/reporting platform
sop: Open the survey rollup report in Power BI
Add a table visual summing responses per team
Compare the per-team sum to the response total on the Responses tab in Microsoft Forms
Done when the per-team sum equals the total response count
verify: Recompute the per-team sums in the Power BI report
Compare the sum to the Microsoft Forms response total
Pass when they match the total

steps.title: Publish the ranked friction list with severity in BI/reporting platform
sop: Open the friction rollup report in Power BI
Build a table ranking friction points by mean severity with affected teams alongside
Add the report date to the page header and click Publish to the engineering workspace
Done when the dated dashboard is live in the workspace
verify: Open the published dashboard in the Power BI engineering workspace
Check the ranked list shows severity, affected teams and a report date
Pass when the dated ranked friction list is confirmed

steps.title: Raise a DevEx backlog item for each top-5 friction point in Jira
sop: Open the DevEx backlog in Jira and click Create
Raise one item per top-5 friction point, naming an owner and a target quarter on each
Link each item to the published Power BI dashboard
Done when all top-5 friction points are tracked as owned backlog items
verify: Search the DevEx backlog in Jira for the five new items
Open each and check the owner and target quarter fields
Pass when a DevEx backlog item with owner per top-5 friction point exists

steps.title: Record the Platform Engineering Lead sign-off on the findings page in Confluence
sop: Open the DevEx findings page in Confluence
Review the quarterly findings against the published dashboard
Add a dated sign-off line naming the Platform Engineering Lead and save the page
Done when the dated sign-off sits on the DevEx page
verify: Open the DevEx page in Confluence
Read the sign-off line and its date
Pass when a dated Platform Engineering Lead sign-off is present

steps.title: Confirm the release candidate build is green in GitHub Actions
sop: Open the Actions tab of the delivery repository in GitHub Enterprise
Open the release-candidate workflow run for the mainline commit being cut
Check every job in the run shows a green check
Done when the run for the mainline commit is green
verify: Open the RC workflow run in GitHub Actions
Check the run status for the merged mainline commit
Pass when a green result for the merged mainline commit is confirmed

steps.title: Create the annotated SemVer tag on the release commit in GitHub Enterprise
sop: Check out the release commit from the delivery repository in GitHub Enterprise in a local clone
Run git tag -a vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH -m with the release message on that commit
Run git show on the new tag to read the author, date and target SHA
Done when the annotated tag points at the release SHA
verify: Open the Tags page of the repository in GitHub Enterprise
Open the new tag and read its format, annotation and target commit
Pass when SemVer format plus annotation on the release commit are confirmed

steps.title: Write the release notes into the tag annotation in GitHub Enterprise
sop: Open the draft release notes on the release page in Confluence
Paste the notes into the tag annotation message in the local clone of the repository
Run git show on the tag to read the message back
Done when the tag message carries the release notes
verify: Open the tag on the repository Tags page in GitHub Enterprise
Read the annotation body
Pass when the release notes are present

steps.title: Reconcile the tag SHA to the CI build commit SHA in GitHub Actions
sop: Open the RC workflow run in GitHub Actions and copy the commit SHA it built
Open the tag on the repository Tags page and copy its target SHA
Compare the two SHAs character for character
Done when the tag SHA and the CI build SHA match exactly
verify: Open the run in GitHub Actions and the tag in GitHub Enterprise side by side
Compare the run commit SHA to the tag target SHA
Pass when no mismatch is found

steps.title: Reconcile the tag version to the artifact metadata version in GitHub Enterprise
sop: Open the release assets on the Releases page of the repository in GitHub Enterprise
Read the version in the metadata file of each artifact
Compare each artifact version to the tag version before the tag is pushed
Done when the artifact versions match the tag before the push
verify: Open the release assets in GitHub Enterprise
Compare the artifact metadata version to the tag
Pass when the artifact version equals the tag

steps.title: Reconcile the tag version to the container image tag in GitHub Enterprise
sop: Open the Packages page of the repository in GitHub Enterprise
Open the release container image and read its tag
Compare the image tag to the git tag, the CI SHA and the artifact version
Done when the four-way reconcile shows no mismatch
verify: Open the package registry in GitHub Enterprise
Compare the image tag to the release tag
Pass when the image tag equals the release tag

steps.title: Push the immutable tag to the repository in GitHub Enterprise
sop: Confirm the SHA, artifact and image reconciles all passed
Run git push origin with the tag name from the local clone
Open Settings > Tags on the repository in GitHub Enterprise and add a rule blocking tag deletion
Done when the tag is public with no re-tag allowed
verify: Open the Tags page of the repository in GitHub Enterprise
Search for the pushed tag name
Pass when the pushed tag exists exactly once

steps.title: Record the changelog with the CI build number in Confluence
sop: Open the release page in Confluence and click Edit
Add a changelog row with the tag, the commit SHA, the CI build number and a UTC timestamp
Publish the page
Done when the release page is updated
verify: Open the release page in Confluence
Read the changelog row for the release
Pass when the changelog entry with build number plus SHA is confirmed

steps.title: Log an SDLC-Exception for any superseded tag in Jira
sop: Open the SDLC project in Jira and click Create, picking the SDLC-Exception issue type
Name the superseded tag and the replacement patch version in the description
State that a new patch version ships instead of delete-and-retag, then save the ticket
Done when the exception documents the superseded tag
verify: Open the SDLC-Exception ticket in Jira
Read the superseded tag and the replacement version in the description
Pass when the superseded tag plus replacement version are documented

steps.title: Record the Tech Lead sign-off on the release page in Confluence
sop: Open the release page in Confluence
Ask the Tech Lead to review the tag, changelog and reconcile evidence
Record the dated Tech Lead approval line on the page and save
Done when the sign-off is on the release page
verify: Open the release page in Confluence
Read the approval line and its date
Pass when a dated Tech Lead sign-off is present

steps.title: Run the quarterly untagged-articles audit query in Confluence
sop: Open the Engineering space in Confluence and open the saved untagged-articles search
Run the search scoped to the current quarter
Export the result list as the tagging worklist
Done when the in-scope article list is produced
verify: Re-run the untagged-articles search in Confluence
Compare the results to the tagging worklist
Pass when the list matches the tagging worklist

steps.title: Apply the domain tag from the controlled taxonomy to each article in Confluence
sop: Open each worklist article in Confluence
Click the label editor and add the domain or value-stream label from the controlled taxonomy
Remove any free-text domain label and save the article
Done when none carries a free-text label
verify: Open a sample of worklist articles in Confluence
Read the domain label on each against the controlled taxonomy list
Pass when domain tags come from the controlled taxonomy

steps.title: Apply the component tag to each article in Confluence
sop: Open each worklist article in Confluence
Click the label editor and add the component label matching the CMDB component list
Save the article
Done when no worklist article lacks a component label
verify: Open a sample of worklist articles in Confluence
Check each component label against the approved CMDB list
Pass when each carries a component tag from the approved list

steps.title: Apply the lifecycle status tag to each article in Confluence
sop: Open each worklist article in Confluence
Click the label editor and add the lifecycle status label
Save the article
Done when no worklist article lacks a lifecycle status label
verify: Open a sample of worklist articles in Confluence
Read the lifecycle status label on each
Pass when a lifecycle status tag is present on each

steps.title: Apply the owner tag to each article in Confluence
sop: Open each worklist article in Confluence
Click the label editor and add the owner label for the accountable team
Count the labels on the article after saving
Done when every in-scope article has at least 3 required tags
verify: Open a sample of worklist articles in Confluence
Check the owner tag and count the required tags on each
Pass when an owner tag plus the 3-tag minimum are confirmed

steps.title: Remove any off-taxonomy label found during the pass in Confluence
sop: Open the label taxonomy report for the Engineering space in Confluence
Open each article carrying an off-taxonomy label and remove the label in the editor
Re-run the report after the cleanup
Done when the taxonomy report shows no orphan labels
verify: Run the label taxonomy report in Confluence
Scan the output for off-taxonomy labels
Pass when zero orphan labels are found

steps.title: Raise a KM-hygiene ticket for each untaggable article in Jira
sop: Open the KM project in Jira and click Create for each untaggable article
Set the disposition field to archive, rewrite or keep and paste the article URL
Set the due date 10 business days out
Done when the 10-business-day SLA is set
verify: Open the KM-hygiene tickets in Jira
Check one ticket per untaggable article with a disposition set
Pass when one per untaggable article with a disposition is confirmed

steps.title: Re-run the audit query to confirm zero untagged articles in Confluence
sop: Re-run the untagged-articles search in Confluence at the end of the pass
Add the tagged count to the archived count and compare the sum to the in-scope total
Tag or ticket any article still returned
Done when tagged plus archived equals the in-scope total
verify: Re-run the audit search in Confluence
Read the result count
Pass when it returns zero untagged in-scope articles

steps.title: Save the audit query export with the run date in Confluence
sop: Export the audit search results to a file from Confluence
Attach the export to the tagging report page in the Engineering space
Add the run date and the quarter tag to the attachment name
Done when the dated export is stored
verify: Open the tagging report page in the Engineering space in Confluence
Check the attached export name for the run date and quarter tag
Pass when the dated audit export for the quarter is confirmed

steps.title: Record the Tech Lead sign-off on the tagging report in Confluence
sop: Open the tagging report page in Confluence
Ask the Tech Lead to review the export and the zero-untagged result
Record the dated Tech Lead approval line on the page and save
Done when the sign-off is on the report page
verify: Open the tagging report in Confluence
Read the approval line and its date
Pass when a dated Tech Lead sign-off is present

sop: Open the release test cycle in Jira
Add every case covering the interface contract and the error paths to the cycle
Compare the loaded case list to the planned set on the test plan
Done when the planned set is in the cycle
verify: Open the release test cycle in Jira
Compare the loaded cases to the planned set on the test plan
Pass when the planned case set is loaded

steps.title: Record the staging build version on the test cycle in Jira
sop: Open the release test cycle in Jira and click Edit
Enter the promoted staging build version in the environment field
Save the cycle so each execution records against that build
Done when every execution ties to that build
verify: Open the test cycle in Jira
Read the environment build version field
Pass when the environment build version is recorded

steps.title: Verify the consumer-provider pact for the interface in Pact Broker
sop: Open the interface's consumer-provider pair in Pact Broker
Trigger the provider verification for the release candidate versions
Refresh the matrix and read the verification result
Done when the pair shows verified
verify: Open the pair matrix in Pact Broker
Read the verification result for the RC versions

steps.title: Record the pass or fail result on each executed case in Jira
sop: Open each executed case in the release test cycle in Jira
Set the execution status to pass or fail against the case's test case ID
Save each case
Done when no executed case lacks a result
verify: Open the release test cycle in Jira and scan the execution list
Check each executed case for a pass or fail status
Pass when every executed case shows pass or fail

steps.title: Link a defect to each failed test case in Jira
sop: Open each failed case in the release test cycle in Jira
Click Link and attach a defect ticket with its severity set
Save each case
Done when no failed case lacks a defect link
verify: Open the failed cases in the cycle in Jira
Check each for a linked severity-rated defect

steps.title: Record a fix or waiver disposition on each linked defect in Jira
sop: Open each linked defect in Jira
Set the disposition field to fix or waiver
For each waiver, record the approver sign-off on the release ticket
Done when waivers carry sign-off on the release ticket
verify: Open the linked defects in Jira
Read the disposition on each and the waiver sign-offs on the release ticket
Pass when each carries a fix or waiver disposition

steps.title: Reconcile the executed count to the planned count in Jira
sop: Open the release test cycle summary in Jira
Compare the executed count to the planned count
Execute or formally descope any not-run case
Done when zero cases remain not-run
verify: Open the cycle summary in Jira and compare planned versus executed
Filter for not-run cases
Pass when zero not-run cases are confirmed

steps.title: Confirm the critical case pass rate reached 100 percent in Jira
sop: Open the release test cycle in Jira and filter cases by critical plus high priority
Check the execution status on every filtered case
Chase any non-pass to resolution before certification
Done when 100 percent pass before certification
verify: Filter the critical cases in the cycle in Jira
Check the status on each
Pass when every one shows pass

steps.title: Attach the execution report with the build SHA to the release cycle in Jira
sop: Open the release cycle in Jira and click Attach
Upload the timestamped execution report and the contract test results with the build SHA
Check both files appear on the cycle
Done when both sit on the cycle
verify: Open the cycle attachments in Jira
Read the report timestamp and the build SHA inside it
Pass when the report carries timestamp plus build SHA

steps.title: Record the certification sign-off on the release ticket in Jira
sop: Open the release ticket in Jira
Ask the Tech Lead to review the cycle results and certify the integration
Post the certification comment with the release artifact link
Done when the sign-off is stored with the release artifact link
verify: Open the release ticket in Jira
Read the certification comment and its date
Pass when a dated certification sign-off is present

tasks.taskName: Test end-to-end flows in dev environment

steps.title: Map each acceptance criterion to an E2E spec on the story in Jira
sop: Open each Ready for QA story on the team board in Jira
Add the matching E2E spec ID next to each acceptance criterion in the story description
Save each story
Done when no criterion is unmapped
verify: Open the Ready for QA stories in Jira
Check each acceptance criterion for a referenced spec ID
Pass when each criterion references an E2E spec ID

steps.title: Add two negative-path specs per story to the suite in GitHub Enterprise
sop: Open the E2E suite folder of the repository in GitHub Enterprise
Add the happy-path spec plus two negative-path specs per story on a branch
Tag each spec with the story key and open a pull request
Done when the merged specs reference the story key
verify: Search the suite in GitHub Enterprise for each story key
Count the negative-path specs tagged per story
Pass when two negative-path specs tagged per story key are confirmed

steps.title: Run the E2E suite against the dev environment in GitHub Actions
sop: Open the Actions tab of the repository in GitHub Enterprise
Check the E2E workflow triggered on the merge to develop, or start it via Run workflow
Check the run's environment parameter points at the dev build
Done when the suite executes against the dev build
verify: Open the E2E run in GitHub Actions
Read the environment and build version in the run log
Pass when it executed against the dev environment version

steps.title: Confirm the run completed inside 15 minutes in GitHub Actions
sop: Open the completed E2E run in GitHub Actions
Read the total duration on the run summary
Compare the duration to the 15-minute ceiling
Done when the suite finished under 15 minutes on the CI runner
verify: Open the run summary in GitHub Actions
Read the duration
Pass when it is under 15 minutes

steps.title: Check every critical-path assertion is green in GitHub Actions
sop: Open the E2E run results in GitHub Actions
Filter the results to the critical-path flow group
Check every assertion in the group shows green
Done when 100 percent show green
verify: Filter the critical-path results in the run in GitHub Actions
Scan for red assertions
Pass when zero red assertions are confirmed

steps.title: Check the full-suite green rate meets the 98 percent floor in GitHub Actions
sop: Open the run summary in GitHub Actions
Divide the passed spec count by the total spec count to compute the green rate
Compare the rate to the 98 percent floor
Done when it is at or above 98 percent
verify: Recompute the rate from the run summary in GitHub Actions
Compare it to the 98 percent floor
Pass when at least 98 percent green is confirmed

steps.title: Confirm quarantined flaky specs stay at or under 2 percent in GitHub Actions
sop: Open the quarantined-spec report of the E2E run in GitHub Actions
Count the quarantined specs and divide by the total spec count
Check each quarantined spec has a fix ticket inside the 5-day fix SLA
Done when it holds at most 2 percent of specs
verify: Count the quarantined specs in the run report in GitHub Actions
Divide by the total spec count
Pass when the share is at or under 2 percent

steps.title: Raise a defect for each failing flow on the story in Jira
sop: Open the story for each failing flow in Jira
Click Create and raise a Defect with severity, assigned to the owning developer
Link the defect to the failing flow's story
Done when no failing flow is untracked
verify: Open the failing flows' stories in Jira
Check each for a linked assigned Defect
Pass when each links to an assigned Defect

steps.title: Waive a red promotion gate only via an SDLC-Exception ticket in Jira
sop: Open the SDLC project in Jira and create an SDLC-Exception ticket for the red gate
Name the Engineering Manager as owner on the ticket
Set the due date 10 business days out
Done when the 10-business-day SLA is set
verify: Open the SDLC-Exception in Jira
Read the owner and the due date
Pass when owner plus SLA before any waived promotion is confirmed

steps.title: Confirm the run artifacts carry the 90-day retention in GitHub Actions
sop: Open Settings > Actions on the repository in GitHub Enterprise
Check the artifact retention setting reads 90 days
Open the run artifacts and check the JUnit plus trace files carry the commit SHA tag
Done when 90-day retention applies
verify: Open the artifact settings in GitHub Actions
Read the retention value and the artifact names
Pass when 90-day retention with SHA tagging is confirmed

steps.title: Record the Test Lead sign-off on the test cycle in Jira
sop: Open the test cycle in Jira
Ask the Test Lead to review the run results against the exit criteria
Post the dated Test Lead approval comment before staging promotion
Done when the sign-off is on the cycle before staging promotion
verify: Open the test cycle in Jira
Read the approval comment and its date
Pass when a dated Test Lead sign-off is present

steps.title: Execute the contract test for each critical interface in Pact Broker
sop: Open the release pair list in Pact Broker
Trigger verification for each critical interface contract at the RC versions
Refresh the matrix and check every critical pair shows verified
Done when every critical interface shows verified
verify: List the release pairs in Pact Broker
Check each critical interface row for a verified contract
Pass when a verified contract per critical interface is confirmed

steps.title: Run the end-to-end data-flow test for each interface against staging in GitHub Actions
sop: Open the Actions tab of the integration repository in GitHub Enterprise
Run the e2e data-flow workflow against the staging deploy
Check each critical flow appears in the run's executed test list
Done when every critical flow executes
verify: Open the staging run in GitHub Actions
Check each critical interface for an executed e2e test
Pass when an executed e2e test per critical interface is confirmed

steps.title: Validate payload field mappings against the interface spec in GitHub Actions
sop: Open the schema-validation stage of the staging run in GitHub Actions
Read the validation results for request and response payloads
Compare each reported field mapping against the interface spec
Done when request plus response payloads match the spec
verify: Read the schema-validation stage output in GitHub Actions
Scan for mapping failures
Pass when zero mapping failures are confirmed

steps.title: Reconcile source record counts to landed rows in Enterprise data warehouse/lakehouse
sop: Open a worksheet in Snowflake against the staging database
Run the reconciliation query comparing source record counts to landed rows per critical flow
Read the variance column for each flow
Done when the variance is exactly zero
verify: Re-run the reconciliation query in a Snowflake worksheet
